issues.description: The partial GuardInPath rename removes variant None but leaves six cursor predicates and invariants referring to it, so the Verus target no longer compiles or verifies.
issues.rationale: 6082813f renames GuardInPath::{ReadLocked,WriteLocked,None} to {Read,Write,ImplicitWrite,Unlocked} but misses exactly six GuardInPath `is None` tests in wf, wf_unlock, wf_with_lock_protocol_model, two lock_range clauses, and unlock_range. Other `is None` expressions are Option tests and valid. Repair 498f3986 changes these six sites to Unlocked; the same target changes from a deterministic enum-resolution failure to 502 verified and zero errors.
